title: Arkansas 2125 Beta 0.5 is out + New Trailer
author: No_Piano_1857
selftext:
Hi everyone!

I'm a solo developer working on Arkansas 2125, a turn-based post-apocalyptic RPG.

Beta 0.5 is now available, adding a brand-new alternative ending, new quests, NPCs, items, and a new location in Washington, D.C.

I've also released a new trailer showing the game and some of the new content.

Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4546490/Arkansas\_2125/

I use AI during development mainly for creating and editing textures and for translating game content. It helps me speed up these parts of development while I focus on programming, game design, quests, and world building.

I'd love to hear how other indie developers are using AI in their projects!
